title: Map your tensor onto PyTorch and train one epoch
brief: Write Linear and MLP, a step that zeros the gradient, one training epoch, an eval pass, and an einsum attention blend.
hints: nn.Linear stores weight as (out_features, in_features). The forward pass is x @ weight.T + bias.
backward adds into .grad. sgd_step has to zero every gradient after reading it, or the next step doubles.
Shuffle with a torch.Generator seeded locally. Softmax the attention scores over the source axis, and subtract the max before exp.
